findings.title: Authenticated users can amplify funded NPC calls across arbitrary rooms
findings.description: The worked policy allows every authenticated user to create and read arbitrary room IDs. Each room receives the funded `runAs` identity and may call `npcBrain`; the function gate checks only the platform-controlled module name, not room ownership or an admitted room registry. Per-room `pendingRef` and `npcShouldSpeak` throttling can therefore be multiplied by creating and cold-starting many rooms. The app-level daily ceiling and funded balance bound total loss, but an attacker can still consume that shared allowance and deny legitimate rooms AI service for the remainder of the window.
findings.recommendation: Authorize room admission separately from function origin. Bind each room to an authenticated creator or membership record, limit active rooms per caller, use deterministic or server-issued room IDs, and enforce an aggregate per-user or per-room call budget in addition to the platform-wide ceiling. Where supported, also bind the function gate to an approved room or origin path.
